graderOnly: Outstanding Obligation 1 (Owner DEVELOPING, FailureType IMPLEMENTATION, Reason 'authorization is missing on the new endpoint') corresponds to DEV-003: exportClients in src/routes/clients.js never calls requireAdmin, so signed-out and member requests to GET /clients/export currently get status 200 with every active client's email and phone.

Adding requireAdmin(actor) to exportClients (or an equivalent admin check before the store is read) makes signed-out and member requests return 403 through the existing ForbiddenError mapping in src/router.js, while admin output is unchanged; a targeted node call of handle() is enough for the Developer self-check to verify this.
The existing suite (npm test, 5 tests in test/clients.test.js) does not exercise the export route and passes before and after the fix.
DEV-001 and DEV-002 are correctly DONE; the user already approved the reconciled plan including DEV-003; no other blocker, open question, or material deviation remains.
